status: working continuity contract; not art approval

contract.form: Seven distinct mature sages, together only in stanzas 5–8 and returned to their places in stanza 9.
contract.continuity: Seven individually distinguishable older men in simple cream and ochre ascetic garments, varied natural hair/beard arrangements, prayer beads and staffs only where they fit hands.
contract.anatomy: Every visible sage has one head, two arms, two hands, and two legs with natural proportions; no clones or merged bodies.
never: do not make the group ambiguous or duplicated
